# Data dictionary: synthetic screening dataset

**File:** `synthetic_screening_data_raw.csv`

**This dataset is entirely synthetic.** It was generated by a script for practice. It contains no real people, villages or health records. Blocks and villages are fictional labels.

- **Rows:** 620 (600 unique records plus 20 exact duplicates)
- **Period:** 1 June 2026 to 31 October 2026
- **EPDS items:** not included. Only the total score and the self-harm item score are stored.
- **Cut-off:** a placeholder value of **10** was used to create `Screen_Result`. Replace it with a validated local cut-off in any real setting.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Record_ID | Text | Unique record number (MFS-0001 to MFS-0600) |
| Screening_Date | Date | Date of the screening (mostly YYYY-MM-DD) |
| Block | Category | Fictional block: Block 1, 2 or 3 |
| Village | Category | Fictional village: Village A to Village L |
| Worker_Type | Category | ASHA or ANM |
| Age_Group | Category | 18-24, 25-29, 30-34 or 35+ |
| Stage | Category | Pregnant, Postpartum 0-6 weeks, Postpartum 6 weeks-6 months, Postpartum 6-12 months |
| EPDS_Total | Number | Total score, 0 to 30 |
| Item10_Score | Number | Score on the self-harm item, 0 to 3 |
| Screen_Result | Category | Below cut-off or At or above cut-off |
| Referral_Made | Category | Yes if at or above cut-off or self-harm item above 0, otherwise No |
| Referral_Status | Category | Completed at PHC, Tele-MANAS contacted, Pending, Declined or Not needed |
| Days_To_Referral | Number | Days from screening to a completed PHC referral or Tele-MANAS contact (blank otherwise) |

## Deliberate problems (for practising cleaning)

| Problem | Rows affected |
|---|---|
| Exact duplicate rows | 20 |
| Inconsistent village labels (for example `village a`, `Village-A`, `VILLAGE A`, trailing spaces) | 42 |
| Inconsistent age-group formats (for example `25 to 29`, `25 - 29`, `25-29 yrs`) | 40 |
| Dates written as DD-MM-YYYY instead of YYYY-MM-DD | 15 |
| Missing `EPDS_Total` and `Screen_Result` | 10 |
| Missing `Age_Group` | 6 |

## Suggested cleaning steps (Excel / Power Query)

1. Remove duplicate rows (use `Record_ID`).
2. Trim spaces and standardise village names to `Village A` to `Village L`.
3. Standardise age groups to `18-24`, `25-29`, `30-34`, `35+`.
4. Convert all dates to one date format.
5. Decide how to treat the missing values and document the decision.
6. Add helper columns such as `Month`, `Stage_Group` and `Referral_Completed_Flag`.

## Suggested dashboard measures

Women screened, percentage at or above cut-off, self-harm alerts, referrals made, referral completion rate, average days to referral, with slicers for month, block, village, worker type and stage.
